Do not use conda run for training launch.

changes: Added import fallback for direct script execution via python -u.

Added checkpoint save path backend/fabric_classifier/weights/fabric_clf_last.pt and resume lookup.

Updated low-RAM loader mode to workers=0 and pin_memory=false.

Added decision logging and runtime control flags.
Added APIs to pause downloads, close download processes, and enforce RAM thresholds.
Changed wait_until_ram_below_limit to return success/failure with optional timeout.
Aligned fixed dataloader workers to 0 for low-RAM policy.
Added robust retry/backoff and DNS retry handling.
Added safer temp file replacement and unlink retry logic for Windows.
Added integrity checks and dynamic worker control tied to resource manager.
Constrained worker defaults for low-RAM operation.
